visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Six young women in black t-shirts and bright orange/yellow shorts are kneeling in a horizontal row on a light-colored floor next to an indoor swimming pool. They face the camera with neutral expressions and their hands resting on their thighs. Graphical overlays of Pokémon card packs are arranged vertically on the right side of the frame. (2) The camera remains static as the women initiate a synchronized movement, shifting their weight and beginning to turn their bodies away from the lens. The setting is a modern indoor pool facility with large windows and blue water visible in the background. The lighting is bright and even across the subjects. (3) The women have completed their turn and are now facing completely away from the camera, kneeling with their backs to the viewer. This movement reveals large, colorful prints of various Pokémon character faces on the back of their shorts. The graphical card pack overlays remain fixed on the right side of the frame.
